conclusion: Current evidence supports a two-week trial of database X before any migration commitment.
counterevidence_and_limits: The vendor benchmark ran on hardware unlike the production cluster
No evidence about cost at scale

evidence_table.claim: Database X handled the simulated telemetry load with lower tail latency
No data loss over 400 pilot hours

follow_up_questions: What is the monthly cost at 3x current write volume?
recommended_decision: Run a two-week production-shadow trial; a cost report above budget would change this
